rows.GROWING DARKNESS: A choir of howls fills the air. All Animal opponents receive +10 Combat Skill.
The shadows grow longer around you. Make a Resolve check. If you fail, you lose 1 Sanity per each active Growing Darkness event.
The gravity of your wounds resonates within your very being. If you aren’t fully healed, you receive D6 Psychic damage.
You’re slowly losing your grip over your own mind. If your Sanity is not at its maximum, you automatically lose 1 Sanity.
You feel your spirit drained. Reduce your max Aether by D4.
The very air you breathe is conspiring against your survival. Reduce your max Toughness by D6.
You hear a distant rumbling and feel a chilling gust of wind. All Elemental opponents receive +10 Combat Skill.
Did you hear that? They’re coming for you. Whenever you Take a Breather you not only reduce the Tension Die by one stage, you must also immediately make a Tension Die check.
Your hands are shaking too much. Reduce your Camp Check by -1.
Regardless of how hard you try to concentrate, you just can’t. You can no longer Attune at Camp.
Your spirit feels weaker. Reduce your Spellward by 5.
There’s a shift in the astral currents. All Astral opponents receive +10 Combat Skill.
You turned too suddenly and smashed your hip against a corner. Make a Belt check.
This place… it knows, and it watches you. Make a Resolve check. If you fail, you lose D4 Sanity.
You need a break. You can barely keep your eyes open. The next time you are attacked, your opponent surprises you.

An oppressive, dark will sets its sights upon your party. Roll D6 for each Companion or Minion you have. A result of 1 means they are destroyed. If you have no Companions or Minions you suffer D8 Psychic damage.
A crescendo of cries and screams suddenly fills the halls. Dismiss all other effects in play caused by Growing Darkness. For each effect dismissed this way you lose 1 Sanity and 1 Health.
Vines and roots seem to suddenly grow all around you. All Plant opponents receive +10 Combat Skill.
You are ambushed! Roll on the Combat Encounter table. Your opponents surprise you.
All Demon opponents receive +10 Combat Skill.
A suffocating mist surrounds you. Make an Endurance check to avoid receiving 3D4 Poison damage.
A weakness seems to seep into your very bones. Whenever you receive damage from any source, you receive +1 damage.
Confusion suddenly fills your mind, and you have trouble remembering your actions these last few days. Reduce a Skill of your choosing by 10.
The ever-present chill of the grave becomes even more tangible. All Undead opponents receive +10 Combat Skill.
Your mental wounds are starting to leave physical marks. Anytime you lose Sanity, make an Endurance check. If you fail, you suffer D6 Psychic damage.
A swarm of Hellbats surrounds you. Make a successful check with your weapon Skill of choice; if you pass it you receive 10 XP, but if you fail you suffer D10 Slashing damage.
You hear the faint sound of orders being shouted in the distance. All Humanoid opponents receive +10 Combat Skill.
You blink a few times, snapping out of it; how long have you been staring at nothing? Reduce your lightsource by D4.
The darkness seems to grow thicker and denser. Reduce your lightsource by 2 instead of 1 each time you enter a room.
You are swarmed by the spirits of the angry dead. Make a Resolve check, if you pass it you earn 20 XP. If you fail you lose D4 Sanity.
Your mind becomes dull and you have problems recalling things. All non-combat Skill checks increase their Difficulty and are considered Demanding (-10).
Your mind is suddenly assaulted from within. You suffer D6 Psychic damage per each Madness you have.
The ground trembles, and it feels like each step you take is heavier. All Construct opponents receive +10 Combat Skill.
The ground shakes and debris falls from above. Make a successful Dodge check or receive 3D6 Bludgeoning damage.

An inhuman voice screams, whispers and yells; somehow, you know that’s an Overseer. Roll on the Overseer Influence table. All opponents from this Domain benefit from the result, but they also grant an extra +10 XP when defeated.
